title: Drop It In
hook_vo: Drop in any file, and read the card at a glance.

beats.vo: The plus adds videos, pictures, music or text.
Drop a file on a card, and it swaps the picture.
Every card wears a badge for its kind.
And an orange border means it's on the screen.
